header.name: Verdant Bot 1.0.0 • Bedrock 1.21.114 • Omni-Aware World-Class
header.description: 1.0.0 OMNI-AWARE: Knows every block/item and best use in situation, retains important (iron ore, diamond, sheep, lava pool), structure loot main priority (village, temple, ruined portal=free obsidian, lava pool->portal), adaptive combat for ANY mob list (not hardcoded), quick tool priority #1 never bare-hand, world awareness scanning surroundings, death recovery picks items, upskilling main goal, arbitrary bridging (horizontal/diagonal/up) depending on terrain and goal, amazing parkour. New: core/knowledge.js exhaustive Bedrock registry, core/world-awareness.js scoring, runtime/world-awareness.js iron/sheep/lava tracking, runtime/structures.js portal detection, builder arbitrary diagonal, parkour arbitrary, combat adaptive, equipment quick tool, loot structure multiplier, resource retain scoring. 44 modules.
